sum: Gulfport Energy Corporation engages in the acquisition, exploration, and production of natural gas, crude oil, and natural gas liquids in the United States. It primarily focusses on the Appalachia and Anadarko basins. The company's principal properties are in eastern Ohio targeting the Utica and Marcellus and in central Oklahoma targeting the SCOOP Woodford and Springer formations. Gulfport Energy Corporation was incorporated in 1997 and is headquartered in Oklahoma City, Oklahoma.
ceo: Mr. Domenic J. Dell'Osso Jr. (President, CEO & Director)
